concept: One usual action with its rarer alternatives a press away: the action and a chevron joined into one piece, two focus stops, the chevron opening a Menu.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a split button with a coloured main half and a grey arrow half
default_to_avoid.kind: split button, combo button, dropdown button
default_to_avoid.why_not: two colours make two buttons of unequal weight; Pane gives both halves the same variant, joined by a seam

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: both halves share one variant, so the pair is one action and its options

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the menu half is only its chevron, narrow, so the main action leads

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: two focus stops: Enter on the first runs the action, on the second opens the menu

options: B coloured main half, grey arrow
variants.reason: A keeps one weight for one action (P5). B splits the weight. C hides the usual action behind a menu.

more.why: the menu half holds only the chevron with a narrow inline padding so the main action leads
